title: Number field
statement: A *number field* is a field $L$ of characteristic $0$ that is finite-dimensional as a vector space over its prime field $\mathbf Q$, i.e. a finite extension of $\mathbf Q$. A subfield $L\subset\Omega$ of a field $\Omega$ of characteristic $0$ (for instance of an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}$ of $\mathbf Q$) is a number field when it is one as a field.
